deploy-bot: [deploy started] service=runtime-api env=prod-eu1 tag=release/v2.4.7 sha=abcd1234 started_by=@amanda change_window=22:00-01:00 canary=10%

amanda: Kicking off v2.4.7 canary to 10% in eu1. Will watch metrics for 5m. :rocket:

ryan: seeing a small spike in 502s on the canary hosts (eu1-canary-*) about 30s after rollout started

sasha: looking at the logs now — a few stack traces referencing kv-cache miss + kernel selector warnings. sending link to the live logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/runtime-api/eu1?from=now-10m

carla: can we throttle the canary back to 0% while we triage?

amanda: yes — rolling back canary to 0% now, will follow with a full revert if errors persist

leadsre: agreement from oncall — if errors > 0.5% p50 error budget in next 2m, revert to pinned version v2.4.6. Ping me when you start undo.

carla: running undo and pin. command:```sh
kubectl -n prod-eu1 rollout undo deploy/runtime-api --to-revision=rev-246
kubectl set image deploy/runtime-api runtime-api=redwood/runtime-api:v2.4.6
# verify rollout
kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime-api -n prod-eu1
```

deploy-bot: [rollback initiated] service=runtime-api env=prod-eu1 action=undo tag=release/v2.4.7 -> release/v2.4.6 initiated_by=@carla commit_target=rev-246

carla: taking runtime-api-canary out of the load balancer and starting undo. ETA ~2m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ryan: quick note — some downstreams saw timeouts, FYI to folks on infra team.

deploy-bot: [rollback progress] pods_restarted=4/4, new_pods_ready=3/4, remaining=1

carla: confirmed new pods pulled v2.4.6 image and are passing healthchecks. Re-add LB now.

deploy-bot: [rollback completed] service=runtime-api env=prod-eu1 status=success rolled_back_to=release/v2.4.6 pinned=true duration=00:03:06 details=rollback-by-carla sha=abcd1234->prev=ef12be90

amanda: thanks — monitoring now. dashboard: https://console.redwood/realtime/runtime-api/eu1

leadsre: good call. please capture the specific failure stacktrace + kernel selection logs in the postmortem. assign to @sasha and @ryan.

sasha: will grab logs and create a short incident doc. likely a regression from the kernel selection change in the runtime optimization PR. I'll include the repro steps.

carla: filed incident note in #incidents (short form) and linked this thread. we pinned to v2.4.6 and opened a rollback ticket #OPS-4721 for follow-up hotfix vs revert branch.

amanda: next steps: hold the release until RK confirms fix; if fix is small we will patch and do a controlled canary again during the window.

ryan: ack. marking deploy as reverted in release notes and adding a line to changelog: "reverted runtime-api v2.4.7 due to KV cache mismatch on eu1 canary"

deploy-bot: [audit note] deploy record updated: release/v2.4.7 -> reverted, pinned_to=release/v2.4.6, incident_ref=OPS-4721

carla: closing this thread for the deploy itself. moving discussion to incident doc for root cause and rollforward strategy. :white_check_mark:
